correctness.rationale: For two positive exponential-rate mixtures on the SAME ordered support, the exact hazard-sign numerator is N(t)=sum_{i<j}(lambda_j-lambda_i)(a_j b_i-a_i b_j) exp(-(lambda_i+lambda_j)t). For m=3 its coefficients, indexed by strictly ordered exponent sums, have signs of (r2-r1,r3-r1,r3-r2), r_i=a_i/b_i, which cannot alternate twice; the elementary exponential variation-diminishing lemma gives at most one strict sign reversal. For rates 1,2,3,4 and a=(4,2,1,4)/11, b=(3,1,3,1)/8, q=exp(-t), exact symbolic expansion gives 8A-11B=(q-1)(21q^2-4q+1)<0 and hazard numerator P=11q^4+4q^3+19q^2-18q+2 with exactly two positive roots in (0,1). Independent symbolic expansion and numerical roots q=0.12945426757,0.58138312339 confirm certificates, while Descartes plus rational brackets prove exactly two crossings.
